item.description: I am a trained mathematician who skews heavily toward computer science and programming - perhaps to an extent that I am now more a mathematical computer scientist than a computing mathematician. I started reverse engineering software as a teenager, and have always kept a keen interest in all aspects of low-level programming, program analysis, My professional work has been centered on computer security.
